why: On head, parsing `--foo 2 --foo 1` (duplicate-arguments-array off) gives foo=3 instead of 1, because setKey treats the ordinary coerced value 1 as the count-increment marker and adds it to the existing value; base gives 1 (the finding's array-key example does not fail, since head still returns [1] for `--bar 1` with array:['bar']).
